Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworkservices.omf.outtopic

Class OutTopicEventPropertyLimiter

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworkservices.omf.outtopic.OutTopicEventPropertyLimiter
public class OutTopicEventPropertyLimiter extends Object
Limits the size of each property in an out topic event, so that the event fits within the largest message that the event bus accepts (1 MiB by default for Apache Kafka). An event that is too large is dropped by the event bus and every listener misses the change: a Jacquard connector activity report listing 2,454 elements serialised to 1.3 MB and was lost this way.

A property whose serialised form is estimated to be larger than the limit is shortened: an array or map keeps as many of its leading values as fit, a string is truncated, and any other value is left out. The stored element is not changed - a listener that needs the whole value reads the element.

The size is estimated from the values rather than measured by serialising them, which would double the cost of publishing every event. The estimate allows for the class and type names that each value carries in JSON, which make up most of an event's size when a property holds many short values such as GUIDs.
